page.layout: Running head top, with page number top right. Three parallel columns of place names, the middle column with one wrapped entry ("Wendisch-marck."). Below them a heading across the full width, then three further parallel columns of place names. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.head: Zu der lincken hand stehen nachfolgen-de/ vom Königreich Hispanien und Bur-gund herrührende.

page.notes: Printed "Land ob ꝺ Enß" uses an abbreviated "d" with a stroke for "der"; transcribed as ꝺ. "Kaßincks" and "Lybein" are as printed and not verified against a source. "Hispolis" is printed so and kept as is. Signature "N 3" is partly obscured at the foot. The running head and page number are printed in black letter and transcribed in roman. Two-line place entries ("Sicilia citra / Pharum.", "Sicilia vltra / Pharum.") are each given as one line. Some list lines in the lower left are faint.
